properties.name: mode
properties.label: Mode
properties.description: Manual: recipients are defined directly in the Recipients section below. Auto: recipients and templates come from the Auto Share Mapping (functionality under development).

properties.name: to
properties.label: To
properties.description: Comma separated addresses and/or hash variables. (Manual mode only)

properties.name: configurationTemplate
properties.label: Configuration Template
properties.description: Configuration template that defines the To/CC/BCC for every participant. It holds participant IDs; each ID's email is resolved by its mapping type (user, group, department, or variable with an email value). All recipients receive the email simultaneously.

properties.name: template
properties.label: Template
properties.description: Select an email template. Used in both Manual and Auto modes; in Auto mode the same template is shared with every participant.

properties.name: dynamicParams
properties.label: Dynamic Parameters
properties.description: Map template hash variables to values. Use full @@key@@ format (e.g. @@username@@). Values support hash variables.

properties.name: attachmentsForm
properties.label: Attachments Form
properties.description: Select the form containing the file upload fields.

properties.name: apiUrl
properties.label: API URL (no attachments)
properties.description: API endpoint for emails WITHOUT attachments. Supports hash variables, e.g. #appVariable.sendEmailURL#. Leave blank to disable sending.

properties.name: apiUrlWithAttachments
properties.label: API URL (with attachments)
properties.description: API endpoint for emails WITH attachments. Used automatically when attachments are present. Supports hash variables, e.g. #appVariable.sendEmailUrlFormData#.
